title.narrative: A total of 206,502 children and adolescents (52 per cent girls) gained access to post-primary education through UNICEF-supported programmes in formal and non-formal sectors. A total of 13,361 adolescents and youth (59 per cent girls) received skill education and vocational training with 70 per cent of participants transitioning to work.;;
